title: Prismalt
body:
# £ Prismalt  
**Support System by Schneeeule_**

Prismalt is a plugin for better moderation of your server. With Discord integration, you always know what's happening on the server.

* Ban system with duration (in days), reason, custom ban message & ingame banlist management
* Report-Command for players
* vanish & silent-join
* Profile with important player information
* Custom chat design, colourcodes & Discord-chatlog

These commands can be executed with the `prismalt.support` permission, allowing supporters to use them without OP power.
